# AXIOM Protocol ($AXIOM)

> AXIOM Protocol is an autonomous DeFi liquidity & tokenomics flywheel built on the Solana blockchain using the Token-2022 standard.

## Overview
AXIOM Protocol implements a non-custodial, programmatically enforced 0.05% transfer fee using Token-2022 Transfer Hook extensions. The accumulated fee tokens are continuously harvested and distributed by an automated crank mechanism.

## Key Tokenomics & Parameters
- Token Standard: Solana Token-2022
- Transfer Fee: 0.05% (Fixed)
- Fee Distribution Flywheel:
  - 70% Deflationary Burn (Permanently removed from circulating supply)
  - 20% Public Bounty / Crank Reward (Incentive for automated harvesting scripts)
  - 10% Dev Treasury (Protocol maintenance and liquidity expansion)
- Mint Authority: Revoked
- Freeze Authority: Revoked
- Primary DEX Pool: Meteora DLMM

## Repository Structure
- `/programs/axiom`: Core Anchor smart contracts written in Rust.
- `/scripts`: Solana CLI and TypeScript scripts for deployment, authority revocation, and fee collection testing.
- `/web`: Front-end landing page assets, SVG visual branding, and Web3 integration code.
- `/docs`: Architectural whitepaper and GEO optimization specifications.

## Technology Stack
- Language: Rust, TypeScript, Python
- Blockchain Framework: Anchor Framework, Solana CLI, Token-2022 Program
- Infrastructure: Meteora DLMM integration, custom Crank bot runners
